review.title: Nhận xét bài viết trên lớp
paragraphs: The given line graph illustrates how renewable energy sources were used in six major countries over a 40-year period, commencing from 1971.

Overall, out of the studied nations, only Finland witnessed signs of decline in its consumption of green energy. Also of note is that Finland consistently had the highest figures throughout the years.

To elaborate, starting at the leading position of the entire chart, 25% of the total energy was generated from eco-friendly energy sources went down progressively by 2% after 40 years. The figures for Denmark, France and Germany, conversely, was a constant growth by 3%, 8% and 9% in the same time.

Regarding other countries, in 1971, the proportion of sustainable energy was utilized in the USA rose significantly from 3% to 18%, this was the highest increase of 15% between 1971 and 2011. The figure for the UK; likewise, continued to went up from 1% to 6% during the same time. These data; however, still remained far below those of other countries. The figures for
review.overall: Em chọn đúng hai ý Overview theo bài học: Finland giảm ròng nhưng vẫn cao nhất. Số liệu đầu–cuối US và UK cùng mức tăng của Denmark, France, Germany phần lớn xấp xỉ chấp nhận; 25%→23% ở Finland cũng đúng nếu chỉ xét hai đầu kỳ. Điều quan trọng còn thiếu là đáy Finland khoảng 16–17% cuối thập niên 1980 rồi hồi phục; ‘went down progressively by 2% after 40 years’ làm người đọc tưởng đường giảm đều. Em cũng cần sửa các câu chồng hai động từ như ‘was generated ... went down’ và ‘was utilized ... rose’, đồng thời bỏ dấu chấm phẩy sau chủ ngữ UK. Trang 6 có ‘The figures for’ chưa hoàn thành, nên kiểm câu cuối sau khi viết.
